text:
Detailed workflow and prompt:

This addictive technique is possible in Seedance with the right prompt.

You must specify that the red arrow should be removed and then followed.

But the most important thing is to provide reference images of the beginning of the path without the arrow.

I've added three reference images of a close-up view of the river.

In the prompt, you must describe the arrow's path.

About a quarter of the time, it will generate an error and show the arrow at the beginning, then it will disappear.

I'm doing more tests to optimize the process and will have conclusions soon.

I call it a tracking shot because that's the term used in the film industry.

prompt: 

Clean up and remove the red arrow from the landscape. Use the path indicated by the arrow to guide a smooth, cinematic camera movement, following that path.

Continuous tracking shot :

 Continuous first-person camera of the dragon  with colossal transparent giant wings, at ultra-high speed, faithfully following the red arrow.

Flight tracking of the dragon with colossal transparent giant wings from a low angle over the river, splashing in the water as it flies, with exotic villages and jungle vegetation surrounding it, following around a white tree with blue light.

Flight tracking of the dragon at speed along the river with a port and an exotic village with orange glass domes.

Flight tracking of the dragon around a colossal giant tree with an ancient white trunk, red leaves, and light inside.

Photorealistic cinematic scene.
content:
Explicitly prompt Seedance to remove an on-screen guide (e.g., Clean up and remove the red arrow from the landscape) while still using it as an invisible motion guide for the camera path.

Provide reference images of the scene without the guide element (e.g., close-up river frames without the red arrow) to help Seedance remove it cleanly while maintaining continuity.

Describe the exact path the removed guide should define (e.g., following around a white tree with blue light, along the river past a port, around a colossal tree) so Seedance can generate a smooth tracking shot along that route.

Use tracking-shot language in the prompt (e.g., Continuous tracking shot, Continuous first-person camera, smooth cinematic camera movement, low angle) to enforce continuous camera motion rather than jump cuts.

If Seedance sometimes renders the guide at the start then removes it mid-clip, rerun generations and iterate on references/prompts since this failure mode occurs about ~25% of the time.

translations.es:
Indique explícitamente a Seedance que elimine una guía en pantalla (por ejemplo, Limpie y elimine la flecha roja del paisaje) mientras la sigue utilizando como guía de movimiento invisible para la trayectoria de la cámara.

Proporcione imágenes de referencia de la escena sin el elemento guía (por ejemplo, primeros planos del río sin la flecha roja) para ayudar a Seedance a eliminarlo limpiamente mientras mantiene la continuidad.

Describa la ruta exacta que la guía eliminada debería definir (por ejemplo, rodeando un árbol blanco con luz azul, a lo largo del río pasando un puerto, alrededor de un árbol colosal) para que Seedance pueda generar un seguimiento suave a lo largo de esa ruta.

Utilice lenguaje de toma de seguimiento en el prompt (por ejemplo, Continuous tracking shot, Continuous first-person camera, smooth cinematic camera movement, low angle) para asegurar un movimiento continuo de la cámara en lugar de cortes bruscos.

Si Seedance a veces renderiza la guía al inicio y luego la elimina a mitad del clip, vuelva a ejecutar las generaciones y itere sobre las referencias/prompts ya que este modo de falla ocurre aproximadamente el ~25% del tiempo.
translations.fr:
Demandez explicitement à Seedance de supprimer un guide à l'écran (par exemple, Nettoyer et enlever la flèche rouge du paysage) tout en l'utilisant comme guide de mouvement invisible pour le chemin de la caméra.

Fournissez des images de référence de la scène sans l'élément guide (par exemple, des plans rapprochés de la rivière sans la flèche rouge) pour aider Seedance à le supprimer proprement tout en maintenant la continuité.

Décrivez le chemin exact que le guide supprimé devrait définir (par exemple, contourner un arbre blanc avec une lumière bleue, le long de la rivière en passant par un port, autour d'un arbre colossal) afin que Seedance puisse générer un plan de suivi fluide le long de cet itinéraire.

Utilisez un langage de plan de suivi dans le prompt (par exemple, Continuous tracking shot, Continuous first-person camera, smooth cinematic camera movement, low angle) pour imposer un mouvement continu de la caméra plutôt que des coupes brusques.

Si Seedance rend parfois le guide au début puis le supprime en milieu de clip, relancez les générations et itérez sur les références/prompts car ce mode d'échec se produit environ ~25% du temps.
translations.ja:
Seedanceに、画面上のガイドを削除するように明示的に指示します（例：風景から赤い矢印をクリーンアップして削除する）が、カメラの経路のための見えない動きのガイドとしては使用し続けます。

ガイド要素のないシーンの参照画像を提供します（例：赤い矢印のない川のクローズアップフレーム）ことで、Seedanceがそれをきれいに削除しつつ、連続性を維持するのを助けます。

削除されたガイドが定義すべき正確な経路を説明します（例：青い光を放つ白い木の周りを通り、港を過ぎて川沿いに、巨大な木の周りを回る）ことで、Seedanceがそのルートに沿ったスムーズなトラッキングショットを生成できるようにします。

プロンプトにはトラッキングショットの言葉を使用します（例：Continuous tracking shot, Continuous first-person camera, smooth cinematic camera movement, low angle）ことで、ジャンプカットではなく連続したカメラの動きを強制します。

Seedanceが時々クリップの開始時にガイドをレンダリングし、その後削除する場合は、生成を再実行し、参照/プロンプトを繰り返します。この失敗モードは約25%の確率で発生します。
translations.ko:
Seedance에 명시적으로 화면 가이드를 제거하도록 지시하십시오 (예: 풍경에서 빨간 화살표를 정리하고 제거). 카메라 경로의 보이지 않는 모션 가이드로 여전히 사용합니다.

가이드 요소가 없는 장면의 참조 이미지를 제공하십시오 (예: 빨간 화살표가 없는 강의 클로즈업 프레임) Seedance가 이를 깨끗하게 제거하면서 연속성을 유지할 수 있도록 돕습니다.

제거된 가이드가 정의해야 할 정확한 경로를 설명하십시오 (예: 파란 빛이 있는 흰 나무 주변, 항구를 지나 강을 따라, 거대한 나무 주변) Seedance가 그 경로를 따라 부드러운 트래킹 샷을 생성할 수 있도록 합니다.

프롬프트에서 트래킹 샷 언어를 사용하십시오 (예: Continuous tracking shot, Continuous first-person camera, smooth cinematic camera movement, low angle) 점프 컷이 아닌 연속적인 카메라 움직임을 강제합니다.

Seedance가 때때로 클립 시작 시 가이드를 렌더링한 후 중간에 제거하는 경우, 이 실패 모드가 약 25%의 확률로 발생하므로 참조/프롬프트를 반복하여 생성 및 반복하십시오.
translations.pt-BR:
Instrua explicitamente o Seedance para remover um guia na tela (por exemplo, Limpar e remover a seta vermelha da paisagem) enquanto ainda o utiliza como um guia de movimento invisível para o caminho da câmera.

Forneça imagens de referência da cena sem o elemento guia (por exemplo, quadros de close-up do rio sem a seta vermelha) para ajudar o Seedance a removê-lo de forma limpa, mantendo a continuidade.

Descreva o caminho exato que o guia removido deve definir (por exemplo, contornando uma árvore branca com luz azul, ao longo do rio passando por um porto, ao redor de uma árvore colossal) para que o Seedance possa gerar uma tomada de rastreamento suave ao longo dessa rota.

Use linguagem de tomada de rastreamento no prompt (por exemplo, Continuous tracking shot, Continuous first-person camera, smooth cinematic camera movement, low angle) para garantir um movimento contínuo da câmera em vez de cortes bruscos.

Se o Seedance às vezes renderizar o guia no início e depois removê-lo no meio do clipe, execute novamente as gerações e itere nas referências/prompts, já que esse modo de falha ocorre em cerca de ~25% das vezes.
translations.zh-CN:
明确提示Seedance移除屏幕上的指南（例如，清除并移除景观中的红色箭头），同时仍将其用作摄像机路径的隐形运动指南。

提供没有指南元素的场景参考图像（例如，没有红色箭头的河流特写镜头），以帮助Seedance干净地移除它，同时保持连续性。

描述移除的指南应定义的确切路径（例如，围绕一棵带有蓝光的白树，沿着河流经过一个港口，绕过一棵巨大的树），以便Seedance可以沿着该路线生成平滑的跟踪镜头。

在提示中使用跟踪镜头语言（例如，连续跟踪镜头，连续第一人称摄像机，平滑的电影摄像机运动，低角度）以强制连续的摄像机运动而不是跳切。

如果Seedance有时在开始时渲染指南然后在中途移除它，请重新生成并迭代参考/提示，因为这种故障模式大约在~25%的情况下发生。
